name: equity_screen_xs_1
study: XSCREEN-1 (xscreen-1011): XS1, the panel screen (daily residual over matched placebo portfolios); pre-registration revision 2 pinned 2026-10-11T03:03:08Z

house_bar.what: this receipt is XSCREEN-1's receipt REBUILT at the House's bar. It is not the study's registered outcome: the registered rule (DR1) adopted c_XS 1.30, and that receipt (sha256 below) stays the study's result
house_bar.rule: the pre-registration's DR5 line, reported beside the decision by the study: the smallest feasible k when every N0-S cell's HOF(k) and UBF(k) are first raised by max(0, b(k)), b(k) its archetype's finite-pool bias in HOF at k in the same set and replicate. The study measured it as 1.38 (this receipt's cost_of_rule.c_XS_with_finite_pool_bias)
house_bar.decided: the captain's decision A23 (2026-10-11): the House runs XS1 at this bar, because a known bias left out of a bar is a loosened rule
house_bar.built: by the study's own code from its saved run: the report (code/xs_report.py) read at k = 138 over the saved jobs (the per-world gate indices of the one real run; no world was simulated again for a calibration, family-wise, bias or power row), and this receipt by code/receipt.py. Only the threshold index differs from the registered receipt's build; `ladder` keeps the registered rule's own row. One assert of xs_report.py (that the decision's k is the registered rule's) was replaced by: the analysis gives the registered k again and gives this k under the bias-raised rule
house_bar.arms: the report-only arms TAIL and STYLE are read at the adopted threshold (the pre-registration's 9.4) and the study saved their reads at its own threshold only, so both were run again at this one by the study's own command (code/xs_arms.py, the pinned panel files, the registered seeds); the same command at the registered threshold gave the study's saved arm results again, field for field. They decide nothing: `style_known_rate`, `style_known_max`, the sentence's style figure, the screen flag and the 'tail' flag read them
house_bar.not_changed: the rule, the stratum, the margin, the placebo bar, the windows, the lineage rule, the limits and the note are the registered receipt's, word for word; the review's notes for a later revision of the receipt are not applied here

rule: XS1 (panel screen), per program, one holdout look per lineage. Series: the daily RESIDUAL x_t = the program's P&L after its costs on E0 (constant-weight lot accounting) minus the cost-free P&L of each lot's matched cell (sector x beta third x 12-1 momentum third, fixed at the lot's decision date). Pre-check on Validation: (RT_V >= 20 or ID_V >= 120) and sum_V(x) > 1e-12. Look on the holdout (194 sessions): pass = pre-check AND sum_H(x) > 1e-12 AND sum_H(x15) > 1e-12 AND t_H >= c_used AND p_plac <= 0.12, with t_H = mean_H(x) / sd_H(x, ddof 1) x sqrt(194), c_used = max(c_XS, c_p + 0.05), c_p the program's own exact floor, and p_plac = (1 + #{999 matched placebo portfolios with t_H >= the program's}) / 1000.

contract.name: C-XS-1
contract.keep_rule: a held slot with a positive target is kept (no trade, no resize); a held slot absent from the target is sold whole; a new slot is bought as one lot
contract.fills: decide at the close of d; fill in session d + 1 at the declared open or close; a lot is never sold in the session it was bought; max_hold_sessions <= 60
contract.costs: half-spread 3 bp on every fill; SEC fee and FINRA TAF on sells, each rounded up to the cent per order; no commission
contract.house_exits: a held name not in U(d) at a session close is sold at the next open; the same exit law binds every placebo counterpart and cell member
contract.ctx: no ticker, no name, no date, no price level, no size or liquidity rank; scale-free per-slot fields, statistical sector and beta

stratum.definition: sector = the sector fund (of those with at least 200 valid returns) whose market-residual returns correlate most with the name's over the 252 sessions to d; beta = OLS on the market fund over the same window (at least 200 valid returns); momentum = c(d - 21) / c(d - 252) - 1. Per sector of n names: (beta groups, momentum groups) = (3, 3) when n >= 45, (2, 2) when 20-44, (1, 2) when 10-19, (1, 1) when 5-9; sectors of 4 or fewer names share one pooled cell. Names sorted by (beta, asset id) into beta groups floor(q nb / n), then within a beta group by (momentum, asset id) into floor(q nm / m).

residual.definition: per lot: cost-free leg returns of every cell member (open entry c/o - 1 at half exposure, held c/c - 1, open exit o/c_prev - 1 at half exposure, close exit c/c_prev - 1); B_t = sum over lots of weight x the mean leg return of the lot's cell members valid that session; x_t = r_t - B_t with r_t the program's P&L after spread and sell fees; x15_t = x_t - 0.5 s_t - f_t; the cell member list is fixed at the decision close (less members failing entry validity) for the lot's life; a member that leaves the eligible set takes the open-exit leg the next session and then drops out of the mean; an invalid own-name leg is neutral
residual.placebo_law: each draw gives every lot a counterpart in its cell; decisions in time order; counterparts of lots exiting at the next fill are released; cells in ascending id, lots within a cell by (weight descending, asset id ascending); one uniform key per member, keys of members the draw already holds raised by 2, the k smallest keys become the counterparts in order; the placebo series is cost-free
residual.seed_rule: numpy default_rng(int.from_bytes(sha256('XS1|' + receipt sha256 + '|' + program code sha256 + '|placebo').digest()[:16], 'big')); one rng.random((999, members)) call per decision and cell; fixed before the look

precheck.rule: (RT_V >= 20 or ID_V >= 120) and sum_V(x) > 1e-12; a failed pre-check spends no look and spends the lineage's try

look.rule: pre-check AND sum_H(x) > 1e-12 AND sum_H(x15) > 1e-12 AND t_H >= c_used AND p_plac <= 0.12 (placebo count <= 119 of 999); t_H undefined (fails) when sd_H < 1e-12 or not finite
look.c_used: max(c_XS, c_p + 0.05) on the 0.01 grid: k_used = max(k_XS, k_p + 5); k_used > 500 is INELIGIBLE
look.stress: sum_H x15 > 1e-12, x15 = x - 0.5 s - f (1.5 times the half-spread, each sell fee twice)

floor.statistic: t_H of the daily residual x, L = 194
floor.cells: (i) both Train-era pools together when both exist with at least 251 sessions each; (ii) each single pool of at least 550 sessions alone
floor.pools: the program's own (x, w) on 2016-01-04..2019-12-31 and 2022-01-03..2024-12-31, from its first decision + 2 sessions
floor.worlds: every holdout block of 194 consecutive pool sessions, circular inside one pool, weighted by its number of non-overlapping Validation blocks
floor.null: N0: x0 = x - w kappa_H, kappa_H = sum_k W_k sum(x) / sum_k W_k sum(w)
floor.ineligible: no floor cell; a cell with no tuple weight; a cell with no k in 0..500 holding 12%; zero exposure; a non-finite series; a session outside the spans; k_used > 500
floor.own_rate: own_fp = the largest over the floor cells of HO[k_used] / T; IN-SAMPLE (at most 12% by construction), no placebo leg; computed on the House, never committed
floor.k_cell: the smallest k in 0..500 with HO[k] x 100 <= 12 x T; k_p = the largest k_cell; c_p = k_p / 100

eligibility.program: a panel program under contract C-XS-1 with at least one floor cell and k_used <= 500; no look when INELIGIBLE or when the pre-check fails
eligibility.universe: U(d): index member on d, d + 1, d + 2; accepted series with a valid close on d and d - 1; the eligible class of its company; beta, momentum and sector defined (253 sessions of history)
eligibility.entry: a valid open and close at the fill session and a valid close the session after

windows.holdout: 2026-01-02 .. 2026-10-09: exactly 194 sessions; later sessions are forward days only

lineage.same_lineage: the same template, or a Train daily correlation of 0.7 or more with a program already looked at or already refused at the pre-check, in either series: the residual x or the universe excess u (the residual computed with one cell holding all of U(d))
lineage.no_feedback: Validation, look, placebo-rank and forward outcomes of panel programs are never fed to a generator
lineage.routes: a lineage that took an XS1 look can take no S2 look, and the reverse; the forward route F-GS-XS is specified in the pre-registration and not measured here

labels.basket: 'basket-led' when the sum over V and H of B_t >= the sum over V and H of x_t, else 'selection-led'
labels.french: OLS of x on (Mkt-RF, SMB, HML, Mom, ST_Rev) daily over V and the covered part of H (at least 120 days, else 'unmeasured'); 'style-loaded: <factors with |t| >= 2.0>' or 'no style loading found'; never a gate

momentum_stratum_power_cost.what: arm RB (sector x beta thirds, no momentum third) minus the adopted stratum, in power; a NEGATIVE value means RB has less power, so the momentum third ADDS power; a positive value would be its cost

beside_calibrated_reading.what: BESIDE the registered decision (the captain's lessons 1 and 3); none of it decides
beside_calibrated_reading.why: the registered rule takes the worst of 96 cell-replicates in the point rate and in a one-seed bootstrap bound, so its threshold is partly a property of the rule; the same pipeline on structureless synthetic prices gives the thresholds below

limits: the screen measures selection inside sector x beta x momentum cells and nothing else: a program whose mechanism is a tilt on those has almost no residual and will rarely pass
a pass is evidence against 'random same-style picks' after costs; it is not evidence of profit and does not say the program beats the index
every rate recombines 6 to 12 calendar years (2010-19 and 2023-24); the bound resamples 6 to 12 year clusters and can itself be too narrow
at +4% a year net residual edge the power is low; '+4% a year' is net of costs and inside the cell mean: the picks' gross edge over their cell-mates is (e + costs) / dilution
c_XS is one number for every program, set by the worst cell, with no credit for any own floor
per program, not per mechanism: one zero-edge rule submitted as several variants takes several looks; the family-wise rate is stated, not capped
a known style is not skill: a no-skill tilt to a style its author knows won the holdout passes more often than the stated rate

SURVIVOR UNIVERSE: the source has no series for most delisted members (member-sessions without data: 26.5% in 2010-16, 14.0% in 2017-19, 5.6% in 2022-24; acquired names 85-100% missing); missing names are outside the programs' universe and outside the cells alike, so residual tails are thinner than live; the 2010-15 worlds are LOW COVERAGE
the study's worlds are not the House's: one year differs at each end, another vendor's bars, a third House floor cell; House bars sit at or above and House power at or below these rows
the planted edge is a constant drift; a real edge is lumpier and passes less often
the study is not blind: its authors knew the broad path of US stocks 2009-2024 and the census's coverage figures
stated_beside_every_live_trade: XS1 (panel screen): judged on the daily residual, this program's P&L minus the P&L of random portfolios that hold the same number of names at the same weights from the same sector x beta third x 12-1 momentum third cells on the same days. Bar: holdout t >= {c_used} (screen bar 1.38, own floor {c_p} + 0.05), ahead of 88% of 999 such portfolios, and positive at 1.5 times the spread with sell fees doubled. Measured false-positive rate at zero residual edge, own floor not credited: at most 10.0% in every cell, 95% upper bound 13.1% (cap 12%, owner's wall 15%); given a top-third 2025, up to 10.7%; rates of real-signal cells are understated by about 2.5 points (finite history). On its own Train-era worlds this program's holdout-only rate is {own_fp}% (in-sample: at most 12% by construction). Earlier XS1 looks in this program's mechanism cell: {n_cell}. A zero-edge mechanism given 8 such looks passed at least one in up to 54.9% of worlds. A pass says its picks beat random same-style picks after its costs; it does NOT say it beats the index: its P&L is {basket}, and market, sector, beta and momentum direction are not counted as edge. French factors: {label}. Contamination: 2025 (all of Validation) and part of the 2026 holdout may be known to its author; names and dates are hidden from the program, but sub-industry, size and value are not matched: a no-skill tilt to a style that won the holdout passed up to 30.0% of such worlds. Flags: {flags}.
note: rates are fractions on the study's worlds at L = 194: HOF = the floor-free holdout-only gate rate at zero NET residual edge (the calibrated quantity: the pre-check and every program's own floor are NOT credited), UBF = the 97.5th percentile of a two-way (calendar year x program) cluster bootstrap of it, HOG and UB = the same with own floors on (beside). fp_zero_edge lists [HOF, UBF, HOG, UB] per archetype and 'SET|NULL' (XH, XL, XCL calibrate; XCH is report-only and has no bound). Worlds recombine real sessions of 2010-19 and 2023-24 by exact enumeration of every holdout start; N0-S = 16 signal-structured siblings demeaned on their path, N0-P = 200 placebo twins centred on their costs only. Every N0-S rate is UNDERSTATED by the finite-pool bias (path-demeaning forces a pool sum to zero): finite_pool_bias lists it per archetype and set as measured on the twins, and finite_pool_bias_max is its largest value. power lists [full gate, holdout-only, gross pick edge] with own floors on.
